Jx.bar_b_note: A large, well-scaled bear-like silhouette, but the noisy yellow-spot pattern over dark plating flattens the form into mottle and the faint is only a crouch, so it misses the owner-bar finish.

Le.bar_b_note: The standing ram is owner-bar quality (clean fleece, dark horns, readable face), but both faint sequences break the read: A's faint mid tangles legs and horns, B's faint mid/end sinks the legs out of sight and lays the horns out as stretched tubes.

Qd.bar_b_note: A's fur reads naturalistic but is a noisy gold-blob mottle and its faint mid floats well above its shadow; B reads clearly but as a smooth terracotta clay toy with moss decals, off the naturalistic style bar, and barely taller than the trainer on either side.

Cj.bar_b_note: B's panel is legible and on-direction (blue-grey translucent, pale border), but the world behind is a murky flat-lit night with no atmosphere, and the hints use small keyboard-style glyphs instead of controller-first prompts.

Hs.bar_b_note: A finished, appealing elder villager with an expressive face and eyes, clear silhouette and an earthy green/brown palette that fits the Meadows key art; the plain dark stage gives no light or atmosphere to judge.

Hf.bar_b_note: Good scale and silhouette, but the yellow-spot mottle makes the surface noisy at small size and the faint end still reads as lying down rather than knocked out.

Wp.bar_b_note: An appealing gold-and-moss lizard with a readable leafy crest, but it is low-slung (head barely above the 1.80 m trainer) and B's hit react launches the whole body into the air off its shadow.

Rw.bar_b_note: B's lifted purple-blue fur brings back some form, but the body is still a dark, low-contrast mound with no readable face or eyes, and the faint poses barely differ from standing.

top_changes.change: Ground and clarify the hurt/faint set: turn off the aspect flame on faint, keep hit reacts on the ground (Wp B), stop faint meshes floating (Qd A faint mid) or deforming (Le B horns/legs), and make faint end read as knocked out (on the side), not a crouch (Jx, Hf, Rw).

Rework creature surfaces to the owner's naturalistic bar: lift Rw's fur value and add a lit face/eye read, and replace the noisy yellow-blob mottle on the Jx/Hf bear and Qd A boar with real fur and plate structure plus a rim light.
Rebuild the Qd boar as a naturalistic, taller-than-trainer model (B's clay-toy body and A's blob coat are both off the style bar).
